    import numpy as np
    import cv2
    image = cv2.imread(image_path)
    image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    image = cv2.resize(image, (0, 0), fx=2, fy=2)
    detector = Detector_Tool()
    
    data = detector.detect(image, threshold=0.65)

        stove_knobs = data["box"]
        stove_knobs = np.array(stove_knobs).astype(np.int32)
